body:
## Human authorization · 2026-10-23 · NATIVE-INGREDIENTS-GEMINI-R01

**Decision: APPROVED.** Human explicitly replied “批准” to the planning review of this Issue #2, authorizing the complete six-stage **bounded read-only** research envelope proposed here. This is permission for execution **within the written object/byte/identity/sensitivity limits**, not acceptance of future findings and not authority to widen access.

| Phase | Authorized live target objects | Maximum cumulative explicitly specified read bytes |
|---|---|---:|
| R01-BIND | active-process root pointer 8B + 75 roster descriptors 1200B; no object-buffer reads | 1,208 |
| R02-PLAYER-HISTORY | two independently vetted Player identity/index slices, ≤12 Slot24 48B records, ≤3 Slot26 records only after native stride validation | 1,262 |
| R03-DRAFT-RELATIONS | ≤6 Slot42 32B DraftData records and ≤3 vetted Slot8 team-identity slices | 486 |
| R04-COACH-BOOK | ≤3 Slot22 Playbook records (360B each) | 1,080 |
| R05-GM-CAP | ≤3 Slot61 DeadCap 136B records and ≤3 Slot71 TradeException 112B records | 744 |
| R06-RECORD-BOOK | ≤10 Slot39 RecordData entries at 52B | 520 |
| **TOTAL** | **Six phase envelopes only** | **5,300B** |

The exact formulas, field ranges, positive/negative controls and per-stage failure conditions in `NATIVE_ATLAS_CODEX_TRIAGE_01/next_round_plan.json` and `GEMINI_NEXT_ROUND.md` are incorporated by reference **as constraints**. Their old `READ_ONLY_PROPOSED` labels mean the files were authored before this decision; this dated Human authorization supersedes their *approval status*, not any byte/object/sensitivity restriction. The executor shall cite this Issue comment as its authorization basis in its Task Packet and Run.

**Conditions remain mandatory:**
- New process identity, executable hash, module base and game context must be checked before reading. Historical PID, heap pointers or save name are not bindings. Without a provable save identity, `UNBOUND` remains required for any save-specific fact/publication.
- Implement a **pre-read allowlist at the lowest available memory-read boundary**, covering helper/constructor reads; account for every actual RPM request and returned byte. Do not proceed if instrumentation or implicit access cannot be bounded. Never transfer unused bytes or samples across object/range limits.
- Do not read or export Potential, unclassified sensitive fields, arbitrary pointer targets or raw whole objects beyond the expressly allowed sampled records. Slice access requires sensitivity review first.
- Read-only process memory only, least privilege. Administrative execution is **not blanket authorization**, and any elevation must meet existing OS guardrails. No game process writes, save load/switch/edit, simulation/advance, native side-effect calls, hooks/injection, unbounded scans, production database writes, core-owned edits, or master merge.
- Within the approved envelope Gemini may reorder hypotheses, stop low-yield probes and pursue static cross-references without repeated approvals. A needed new object, byte range, sample, snapshot time, or action requires a **new scope decision before access**.
- Preserve current build/context, actual low-level call logs, raw safe evidence, positive and negative controls, exact tested commit, OS Run/Inspect and semantic maturity axes. Do not certify an uncertain semantic interpretation or current-save binding from a JSON PASS.

**Execution owner:** Gemini Flash / Antigravity, as a handoff; no process read or agent execution is initiated by this GitHub authorization record alone. Work on an isolated task branch and stop at the current task’s delivery boundary. Codex may receive later hard cases through a separate task.

Human approval covers the six phase scopes **once**, not six individual confirmation cycles.
